hypothesis_en: Two related identity-role clarifications from actual hard failures. A broad product/service category in otherwise equivalent generic marketing is a class label rather than an actual individual item record; the separate city-only service example must not cancel the approved different-category exception. Capitalization, repetition and title/subject placement alone do not create an instance. Conversely, a requested failed object or an actual status/access/liability target is a bound instance even when its surrounding predicate is reusable. Qualify complete non-main equivalence and material/conflict options by that actual binding, rather than treating different failed-object IDs as optional template variables. Preserve the specifically approved citation/provider slots, actual named works/items, real procedures/prices/conditions/routes and independent list additions. Retain the parent scoped-total fix, full already-visible reading context, field names/enums/order, native executor/model/window and all validators. This isolates the observed circular category-identity reasoning and the failed-object basis error without adding another broad body-language or truth rule.
hypothesis_zh: 依据真实硬回归失败，澄清两项相关的身份角色。相同通用营销文字中的宽泛产品或服务类别是类别标签，而非实际单个商品记录；独立的仅城市变化服务例子不能取消既已允许的不同类别例外。大写、重复及标题或主体位置本身不形成具体实例。反过来，即使周围谓词可复用，被请求的失败对象或真实状态、访问、责任目标仍是绑定实例。应按该实际绑定确认完整非主消息的等价性，以及实质差异或冲突选项，不能将不同失败对象ID视为可选模板变量。保留特定允许的引用或服务商槽位、实际命名作品或商品、真实流程或价格或条件或入口，以及独立列表新增条目。保留父版本的显示总数范围修正、完整且已可见的阅读上下文、字段名称或枚举或顺序、原生执行器或模型或窗口及全部校验。本实验隔离已观察到的类别身份循环推理及失败对象依据错误，不增加另一套宽泛正文语言或真伪规则。
